unavailable.title: Profile unavailable
unavailable.description: Open your account to view your profile.

visibility.private: Your profile is private — other people can't see it, and your username won't show up in search.
visibility.public: Your profile is public — anyone can find it by your username or public ID.

header.verifiedHint: This name is publicly confirmed and tamper-proof.

noPublicSkills.title: No public skills
noPublicSkills.description: {name} hasn't shared any skills publicly yet.

error.offlineHint: This profile is shared directly by its owner. They need to be online, and their profile set to public.

talentIndex.title: Let employers find you
talentIndex.description: A talent index is a directory employers search to find people with particular verified skills. Ticking a skill means an employer looking for that skill can find you — not just that the skill appears somewhere. Anyone with access to the index can search it.
talentIndex.nothingSelected: You haven't chosen any skills. You won't appear in a talent index, and no employer can find you through one.
talentIndex.noSkills: You don't have any verified skills yet. Once you earn one, it will appear here as something you can choose to be findable by.
talentIndex.skillsHeading: Skills employers could find you by
talentIndex.identityNote: Your public ID is always included — it is how an employer checks your credentials are real. Your name and bio are not, unless you tick them here.
talentIndex.previewHeading: Exactly what would leave this device
talentIndex.notPublishedYet: No talent index is connected yet, so nothing is being sent anywhere. These choices apply when one is.
talentIndex.withdrawNote: A listing expires after 30 days. Untick a skill and it goes from the next listing; stop entirely and you drop out of the index without having to ask anyone to remove you.

directories.title: Who has asked about you
directories.description: Directories are services that hold records about you — an institution's registry, an employer's index. Nothing is checked unless you add it here, and every request is signed with your key so only you get an answer.
directories.none: You haven't added any directories. Nothing on this device contacts a server about you until you do.
directories.noRequests: Nobody is asking at the moment.
directories.share: Share the skills they asked for
directories.sharesOnlyAsked: Sharing sends only the skills this request named, and only the ones you have agreed to publish. Not your whole listing.
directories.ignoreNote: Doing nothing is an answer. A request you ignore expires, and nothing records that you declined.
directories.noAccess: Nobody has looked, or no directory you've added keeps a record.
directories.accessAggregate: {where} counted you in a report that named nobody
directories.problemNote: A directory that cannot be reached is shown rather than skipped — otherwise it would look the same as one with nothing to report.
directories.publishNote: Publishing sends the record the section above previews. Sending it again replaces what a directory holds, so changing your consent and republishing is how you take a skill back.
directories.consentLink: Choose what you're willing to publish
directories.consentHint: Nothing to publish yet? You have to pick the skills first.
directories.visibilityHeading: Institutions that can see you by name
directories.noGrants: No institution has been granted this.
directories.visibilityNote: Instructors see the learners in modules they teach either way — that is how somebody who is struggling gets helped. This is about administrators, who otherwise see only counts. It ends by itself when your enrolment does.
directories.grantOn: Administrators at {institution} can see your named outcomes
directories.noDirectory: That directory is no longer in your list.
